eco.title: GDP (expenditure approach)
eco.formula:
GDP = C + I + G + (X − M)
C = households · I = firms (gross private domestic investment) · G = government · X = exports · M = imports

eco.title: Real GDP
eco.formula: Real GDP = Nominal GDP ÷ GDP chain price index (GDP deflator) × 100

eco.title: What causes business cycles
eco.formula: Real GDP = C + I + G + (X − M)

eco.title: Full employment (natural rate)
eco.formula:
Natural rate of unemployment = Frictional + Structural
(about 5% = 3% frictional + 2% structural)

eco.title: CPI
eco.formula: CPI = (Cost of market basket at current-year prices ÷ Cost of same market basket at base-year prices) × 100

eco.title: Annual inflation rate
eco.formula: Inflation rate = ((CPI in given year − CPI in previous year) ÷ CPI in previous year) × 100

eco.title: Real income
eco.formula: Real income = Nominal income ÷ CPI (as decimal, or CPI/100)

eco.title: GDP per capita
eco.formula: GDP per capita = GDP ÷ Total population

eco.title: Marginal propensity to consume (MPC)
eco.formula: MPC = Change in consumption spending ÷ Change in income

eco.title: Tax multiplier
eco.formula:
Tax multiplier = 1 − Spending multiplier
(MPC 0.75 → spending multiplier 4 → tax multiplier −3)

eco.title: M2 (money supply)
eco.formula: M2 = M1 + Savings deposits + Small time deposits (less than $100,000)
